notes:
macOS screen recording: Capture a display, window or region with optional system audio, microphone and camera. Pick the source on screen, then use the countdown, floating controls, menu bar or configurable shortcuts to pause, resume, restart or stop. The recording opens in the editor when it is saved.
Recording controls and recovery: Screen and region capture exclude BaoCut by default. Keyboard capture is off by default. BaoCut warns when disk space is low, pauses on system sleep and can recover unfinished recordings from Home.
Edit recordings on desktop and Web: Trim and split linked tracks together, or ungroup to edit them separately. Adjust automatic zooms, cursor behavior, framing and camera layouts. The CLI and agent can also work with recording sessions when the local desktop app is available.
Video format 4: Existing format 3 videos still open and upgrade on the first committed edit. Format 3 snapshots and packages still restore or import. Use BaoCut 3.20 or newer to open format 4 videos.
Relink missing media to a newer file of the same media type. Existing clips switch to the new revision while transcripts, captions and cut sets stay attached to the asset. Undo restores the previous revision.
Subtitle preview and export use proportional curly quotes and apostrophes in Latin text rendered with CJK fonts.
From the Skills page on macOS, you can add the BaoCut CLI directory to PATH in supported shells. This requires an explicit click.
Desktop updates use the system proxy and the baocut.com mirror with GitHub fallback. Interrupted downloads retry and resume when possible, and the final file is checked against its published size and checksum.
Screen capture is enabled on macOS. Windows supports editing recordings, and Windows capture remains disabled by default. The Web editor can edit recordings.
The macOS package requires Apple Silicon and macOS 14 or later. Windows packages are unsigned and require AVX2 and the Microsoft Visual C++ v14 x64 Redistributable. CUDA and Vulkan variants require compatible GPU drivers.
